text: If anomaly type is 'door_left_open' and severity is low (<0.5): notify driver immediately, verify door is closed after 5 minutes, monitor temperature for 10 minutes. If temperature stabilises, continue. If not, escalate to medium severity.

If anomaly type is 'door_left_open' and severity is medium or high: notify driver immediately, dispatch maintenance crew to verify door seal, prepare backup reefer, check cargo integrity, monitor temperature every 5 minutes.

If anomaly type is 'compressor_failure' and severity > 0.5: immediately dispatch backup reefer, reroute to nearest maintenance facility, notify receiver of critical delay, alert warehouse of potential spoilage, activate emergency protocol.
If anomaly type is 'compressor_failure' and severity < 0.5: dispatch maintenance on-site, monitor temperature, prepare backup reefer, continue monitoring, notify receiver of potential delay.
If anomaly type is 'extreme_weather': adjust cooling settings to compensate, monitor every 15 minutes, reroute if weather worsens, notify receiver of potential delay, check fuel levels.
If anomaly type is 'power_outage': immediately dispatch backup generator, alert maintenance, notify receiver of critical delay, transfer cargo if temperature exceeds threshold, document incident.

If anomaly type is 'gps_blackout' and severity is low: continue on planned route, notify dispatcher, monitor temperature, if GPS loss persists for >30 min, escalate to human operator for manual tracking.
If anomaly type is 'gps_blackout' and severity is medium: notify dispatcher immediately, use backup GPS, switch to manual tracking, continue route, update ETA manually.
If anomaly type is 'driver_error' and severity is low: contact driver immediately, correct setting or action, verify door closed, monitor temperature recovery, document incident.

If anomaly type is 'driver_error' and severity is medium or high: contact driver immediately, dispatch supervisor to location, correct issue, monitor temperature, escalate to backup dispatch if recovery fails.
If anomaly type is 'sensor_malfunction': cross-check with backup sensors, verify sensor calibration, replace if faulty, use manual temperature logs, monitor closely, notify maintenance.
If anomaly type is 'vibration_anomaly': slow down vehicle, check cargo stability, monitor for packaging damage, alert receiver of potential damage, inspect on arrival.
If anomaly type is 'route_deviation': verify route change with dispatcher, check for traffic or road closures, update ETA, notify receiver, document deviation reason.
If anomaly type is 'fuel_leak': stop vehicle immediately, check for leaks, call maintenance, arrange replacement vehicle if necessary, notify receiver of critical delay.
